meta.parties: Doraiswami Kurukkal v. Thambipillai Et Al

rules.statement: The 1st substituted defendant should be declared the de jure trustee of the Maviddapuram Kandaswamy Temple, given his long-standing management and the absence of a formal trustee.
rules.supporting_quote: "In such circumstances any Court of equity would hold that, in the interests of the temple and all concerned, the 1st substituted defendant should be held and declared to be the de jure trustee of this temple, and I so declare him to be."
